newsitem.title: PERU: Flemings starts Peru electricity sector as sell.
newsitem.headline: Flemings starts Peru electricity sector as sell.

text.p: Robert Fleming Inc. said Monday it started coverage of Peruvian electricity stocks with a "sell" recommendation.
The firm said the sector's rise on the Lima bolsa in recent months had reduced its potential for further gains.

"In spite of the sector's embedded growth potential and the acumen of the international operators controlling Luz del Sur, Edegel and Edelnor, we believe that the current lofty valuations limit the upside potential," Fleming said in a report.

Fleming recommends that investors wait until after the government's sale next month of up to a 30 percent stake in Luz del Sur before building positions in the sector at what it considered "more realistic levels."
